newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks turn lower, tracking weak bonds.
newsitem.headline: French stocks turn lower, tracking weak bonds.

text.p: French shares slipped into losses, following softer bond markets, traders said.
Market professionals were concerned over U.S. jobs statistics which showed a four percent rise in average hourly earnings on a 12-monthly basis, which may lead the Fed to raise interest rates again.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 4.31 points or 0.17 percent at 2,510.21 at 1422 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was down eight at 2,508 from Thursday's close.
